header: This receives feedback on a PENDING learned query pattern (see src/lib/employees/patternCache.ts and queryOrchestrator.ts): an explicit tick/cross from the person who saw that specific LLM-derived answer. This is the ONLY way a pattern ever becomes 'confirmed' (matchable for everyone else) or 'rejected'. My rule: nothing is ever cached from the LLM path alone, and nothing is inferred from behaviour (no dwell-time signals).

symbols.name: POST
doc: POST /api/employees/pattern-feedback Body: { patternId: number, verdict: "confirm" | "reject" } -- explicit tick/cross

I always return 200 with { ok: true } even when nothing was actually changed (e.g. the pattern was already decided, or doesn't exist) -- this is fire-and-forget telemetry from the frontend's point of view, not a user-facing action that should ever surface an error.
